description: Three bowls are lined up on the green-covered surface in front of you: a light lavender bowl on the left, a dark teal bowl in the middle, and a pale mint bowl on the right. The left hand reaches forward to grasp and lift the lavender bowl while the right hand steadies the middle bowl as a right-hand object; then the left hand lowers the lavender bowl onto the middle bowl to form a stack, and the right hand picks up the mint bowl and places it on top before both hands release.
